settings.title: Auto-activate confirmed custom HOME on cold boot
settings.description: After you confirm Gen5W Home via the 45-second test inside the app, this allows home-switcher to switch default HOME after the 10-second safe boot window. Turn this off to stay on stock Home while keeping the mod installed.

settings.title: Hold ★ button (head unit) opens Gen5W Home
settings.description: Maps a long press of the head-unit ★ button to open Gen5W Home from any screen (even CarPlay/Android Auto). Short press stays untouched.

settings.title: Hold Steering Wheel ★ button opens Gen5W Home
settings.description: Maps a long press of the steering wheel ★ button to open Gen5W Home. Short press stays untouched.
